units.text: We built bootloader that can receive new firmware over LoRaWAN. Our remote update reached 150 field sensors, nobody had to visit the sites.
We went through alarm history in Grafana and grouped sensors with similar noise level. We set new thresholds for each group. So false sensor fault alerts dropped 40%.
Sensor data flow was changed from nightly file transfers to MQTT with message queue. Lost readings dropped under 0.8%.
